children: Palo Alto Networks notched better-than-expected annual recurring revenue growth in the fiscal fourth quarter, though the software group may struggle to accelerate the growth rate further, Bernstein analysts write. Growth in recurring revenue for its next-generation security products increased by 1% on quarter, excluding acquisitions, the analysts say. The group was supported by growth across the company, even without including fast-growing revenues in its recently acquired businesses. Though annual recurring revenue acceleration "may not be long-lived", organic growth should hold around the 27%-28% range for much of fiscal 2027 before decelerating in fiscal 2028, they say. Shares slip 1.6% premarket.(josephmichael.stonor@wsj.com)
